modules.summary:
The syrinx module: the core of the standard, and the shape of a source.

A source is an ES module that imports from "syrinx", exports `meta` and `stems`, and may
default-export a function combining them. A layer, and the mix, return their samples whole or
as a stream the host pulls one block at a time. What the core exports is what the standard
needs a source to have; oscillators, filters and the rest are the project's own code.
`syrinx types` emits these declarations; point an editor at them (a
jsconfig.json, or Monaco's addExtraLib) for autocomplete and hover. Sources are plain
JavaScript -- the types are for tooling, not because anything is compiled from TypeScript.

entries.name: Meta
entries.doc: What a source declares about itself. The fields are checked in this order.

members.name: api
members.doc: Contract version the source was written against: 4. Required; any other is refused.

members.name: name
members.doc: Display name. No default: a source that declares none has none.

members.name: channels
members.doc: 1 (default) or 2. A mono return is duplicated when this is 2.

members.name: sampleRate
members.doc: Preferred sample rate, an integer in [8000, 192000]; a host may override it. Default 48000.

members.name: seed
members.doc: An integer in [0, 4294967295], handed to every layer and to the mix as `ctx.seed`. Default 0.

members.name: loop
members.doc: Declared seamless loop. Passed through to consumers; it changes no sample.

entries.name: Context
entries.doc: What every layer and the mix are given.

members.name: frames
members.doc: Number of frames to produce: round(duration * sr).

members.name: seed
members.doc: meta.seed, the same for every layer. Derive a voice's own with `hash(ctx.seed, "kick")`.

entries.name: StemContext
entries.doc: What a layer is given: the context, plus which layer it is.

members.name: stem
members.doc: This layer's name, as declared in `stems`.

entries.name: MixContext
entries.doc: What the default export is given: the context, plus the rendered layers.

members.name: stems
members.doc:
Each layer by name, as `channels` planes of `frames` samples. Reading one makes the mix
whole-buffer; a mix stream never reads it and gets its layers' blocks as its third argument.

entries.name: Output
entries.signature: export type Output = Float32Array | number[] | [Float32Array | number[], Float32Array | number[]]
entries.doc: What a layer or the mix returns: mono samples, or [left, right].

entries.name: Stream
entries.signature: export type Stream = (offset: number, frames: number) => Output
entries.doc:
A streaming layer: called once per block of BLOCK_FRAMES, in order from offset 0 (the last
block is shorter), returning exactly `frames` samples per plane. State kept in the closure
persists between blocks.

entries.name: MixStream
entries.signature: export type MixStream = (offset: number, frames: number, stems: Record<string, Float32Array[]>) => Output
entries.doc: A streaming mix: `stems[name]` is that layer's block as `channels` planes of `frames` samples.

entries.name: Stems
entries.signature: export type Stems = Record<string, (ctx: StemContext) => Output | Stream>
entries.doc: A source's layers, by name. Names match /^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$/ and keep their order.

entries.name: Source
entries.doc: The shape of a source module.

entries.name: PRELUDE_VERSION
entries.doc: The contract version this module implements: 4.

entries.name: BLOCK_FRAMES
entries.doc: Frames per block of a stream: a constant of the standard (4096).

entries.name: hash
entries.doc: FNV-1a over the arguments, as a seed: `new Random(hash(ctx.seed, "kick"))`.

entries.name: Random
entries.doc: Seeded PRNG (mulberry32). The only randomness a source may use.

entries.name: inBlock
entries.doc:
True while the host is computing one block of a stream; false during a layer's setup and for a
whole-buffer layer. Code that needs the whole render (a peak, an ending) refuses when it is true.
